# Reservas Kalawala — Vacation Rentals in Puerto Viejo, Costa Rica

> Kalawala is a family-run vacation rental company offering fully equipped houses and villas in Puerto Viejo de Talamanca, Limón, Costa Rica. We manage 10 properties sleeping 2–6 guests, all with private kitchens, bathrooms, A/C, and free WiFi. Book directly on our website for the best rates — cheaper than Airbnb or Booking.com. Bilingual site (English and Spanish).

## Properties — Puerto Viejo Town (Kalawala Houses)

- [Casa Geco](https://www.reservaskalawala.com/Geco): 2-bedroom house, sleeps 5, private fenced parking, pet friendly (max 2 pets, no extra fee), tiny garden for dogs next to the parking, in the heart of town. Fully equipped kitchen, A/C, WiFi.
- [Casa Rana](https://www.reservaskalawala.com/Rana): 2-bedroom house, sleeps 5, private fenced parking, pet friendly (max 2 pets, no extra fee), small fenced garden — ideal for traveling with pets. Fully equipped kitchen, A/C, WiFi.
- [Casa Tucano](https://www.reservaskalawala.com/Tucano): 2-bedroom wooden apartment above Italian bakery, sleeps 5, terrace, pet friendly (max 2 pets, no extra fee). Fully equipped kitchen, A/C, WiFi.
- [Casa Pappagallo](https://www.reservaskalawala.com/Pappagallo): 2-bedroom wooden apartment above Italian bakery, sleeps 5, terrace, pet friendly (max 2 pets, no extra fee). Remodeled by Spanish interior designer in 2021. Fully equipped kitchen, A/C, WiFi.
- [Casa Delfines](https://www.reservaskalawala.com/Delfin): 2-bedroom house, sleeps 6, 2 bathrooms, private fenced parking for 2 vehicles. Fully equipped kitchen, A/C in the bedrooms, WiFi. No pets.

## Properties — Playa Chiquita (Bungalows)

- [Casa Areka](https://www.reservaskalawala.com/Areka): 1-bedroom bungalow, sleeps 2, about 200 m from Playa Chiquita beach. Fully equipped kitchen, A/C, WiFi, small porch, private parking outside the property.
- [Casa Giulia](https://www.reservaskalawala.com/Giulia): 2-bedroom house, sleeps 4, 2 bathrooms, about 200 m from Playa Chiquita beach. Gas kitchen, A/C, WiFi, private covered patio, parking for one car outside the property.
- [Casa Plumeria](https://www.reservaskalawala.com/Plumeria): 1-bedroom bungalow, sleeps 2, about 200 m from Playa Chiquita beach. Fully equipped kitchen, A/C, WiFi, small porch, private parking outside the property.

## Properties — Villas with Private Pool (Playa Chiquita)

- [Villa Mar](https://www.reservaskalawala.com/VillaMar): 1-bedroom villa, sleeps 2, private pool, king-size bed, dedicated workspace with ethernet, fully equipped kitchen, A/C, WiFi.

## Location & Area

Puerto Viejo de Talamanca is on Costa Rica's Caribbean coast in Limón province. The town is surrounded by tropical rainforest and borders two National Parks: Manzanillo Wildlife Refuge and Cahuita National Park. Known for stunning beaches (Playa Cocles, Playa Chiquita, Punta Uva), surfing, wildlife, and vibrant nightlife.

Getting around: bike or scooter rental recommended. Public bus service connects to Cahuita, Manzanillo, and Sixaola. Properties with parking noted above.

## All Amenities (standard across properties)

- Fully equipped private kitchen (microwave, coffeemaker, blender)
- Private bathroom with towels and toiletries
- Air conditioning

- Bed linens included
- Roku TV with entertainment system and HDMI port
- Cleaning service for stays of 5+ nights (all homes except Areka, Giulia and Plumeria)
- Pack-and-play crib available on request
- Pets welcome only at Casa Geco, Rana, Tucano and Pappagallo: max 2 pets, no extra fee
- 15% discount at on-site Italian bakery
